name: Interior

text: The fares board. Everywhere on the line, and what it costs to get there.
AURELINE, SECOND CLASS: less than a night at an inn.
MIREHAVEN: not listed. The line does not go there and it never will.
A map of the line under glass, drawn straight because a line drawn straight is easier.
Every station on it is a dot except one, which is a square with four roads into it.
Nothing on this map is to scale and nobody looking at it has ever minded.

_plan: A waiting room, which is a kind of room this game has not had: the only place in Caelora where strangers sit in rows facing the same way because a machine is coming at a time. Two of them are Foundation and they are perfectly pleasant, which is exactly the note Act 4 needs from Meridian before Aureline.
